unsupported: Hamel Fabricating Co. was founded in 1978 in Coventry, Rhode Island, as a family-owned and operated business specializing in metal fabrication for residential applications.
Services include design consultation, fabrication, and installation coordination for homeowners and contractors alike.
Customers are primarily residential property owners and local contractors in the Providence, Rhode Island area who need code-compliant basement egress doors or decorative and structural railings.
The company does not advertise service to commercial, industrial, or institutional markets.
Hamel Fabricating highlights its four-decade track record and family ownership as key differentiators, promoting free estimates and a hands-on approach to custom fabrication.
The slogan "We Make Anything But Money!" reflects a service-first ethos rather than a specific technical capability.
